title: Golomb ruler with 29 marks, shortest known
statement: Place 29 marks on a ruler (integers) so that all differences between two marks are distinct, with the ruler as short as possible. The shortest known ruler with 29 marks has length 623 (Atkinson and Hassenklover, 1984, in J. B. Shearer's table); a shorter one improves it. Rulers with up to 28 marks are proved optimal.
submission: Text file: the 29 marks, integers separated by whitespace or commas.
score: the length (largest minus smallest mark; smaller is better)

best_known.source: G(29) <= 623: Atkinson and Hassenklover (1984), in J. B. Shearer's table of Golomb rulers and Leaps in Bounds (github.com/daniel-munro/leaps-in-bounds), data at commit 4521e13 (8 Nov 2026); read 8 Nov 2026
